sentences.en: Have you ever had one of those conversations where half the people in the room have a very strongly held opinion,
sentences.zh: 你是否经历过这样一种对话：房间里有一半的人持有非常坚定的观点，

sentences.en: and the other half feel just as strongly in the opposite direction?
sentences.zh: 而另一半人则抱有同样坚定的相反立场？

sentences.en: This happened to me a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 几年前我就遇到过这种事。

sentences.en: I was having dinner with friends in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在华盛顿特区和朋友们共进晚餐。

sentences.en: Everyone was talking about some shocking news that had just come out.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在讨论刚刚爆出的一条令人震惊的新闻。

sentences.en: First, tens of thousands of top-secret documents from the National Security Agency, or NSA, had been leaked to journalists.
sentences.zh: 首先，国家安全局（简称国安局，即NSA）的数万份绝密文件被泄露给了记者。

sentences.en: Since at least 2008, the National Security Agency has been using secret technology to hack into...
sentences.zh: 至少从2008年开始，国家安全局就一直在使用秘密技术入侵……

sentences.en: Secret and far-reaching, and it's been going on for years.
sentences.zh: 这些技术既秘密又影响深远，而且已经持续多年。

sentences.en: The government can compel a phone company to provide this metadata, as it's called, for millions of customers.
sentences.zh: 政府可以强迫电信公司为数百万客户提供此类所谓的元数据。

sentences.en: The man who released all these documents was Edward Snowden, a computer security consultant at the NSA.
sentences.zh: 发布所有这些文件的人是爱德华·斯诺登，他是国安局的一名计算机安全顾问。

sentences.en: The documents detailed extensive, secret U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些文件详细披露了美国广泛且秘密进行的

sentences.en: surveillance of people and governments across the globe.
sentences.zh: 针对全球民众和政府的监听活动。

sentences.en: Edward Snowden believed that what the NSA was doing was wrong, and that the public had a right to know.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·斯诺登认为国安局的做法是错误的，公众有权知道真相。

sentences.en: I don't want to live in a world where everything that I say, everything I do, everyone I talk to,
sentences.zh: 我不想生活在这样一个世界里：我说的每一句话、做的每一件事、交谈过的每一个人、

sentences.en: every expression of creativity or love or friendship, is recorded.
sentences.zh: 每一个创造力、爱意或友谊的表达，都被记录在案。

sentences.en: Fearing, correctly, that he was in the crosshairs of U.S.
sentences.zh: 由于担心自己成为美国
安全机构的靶子——这种担忧是正确的——

sentences.en: Edward Snowden fled the United States and found refuge in Russia.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·斯诺登逃离了美国，在俄罗斯找到了避难所。

sentences.en: Back at the dinner table with my friends that night, someone asked a simple question.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，当我回到朋友们的餐桌旁时，有人提出了一个简单的问题。
爱德华·斯诺登，是英雄还是叛徒？

sentences.en: One side of the dinner party was certain.
sentences.zh: 晚宴的一方对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: He had acted in the public interest, alerting Americans to heavy-handed surveillance by their government.
sentences.zh: 他采取了符合公众利益的行动，提醒美国人注意其政府的高压监控。

sentences.en: Edward Snowden was a traitor, who shares national security secrets that embarrass your country,
sentences.zh: 爱德华·斯诺登是个叛徒，他泄露了让国家难堪的国家安全机密，
情报特工和军人的生命，

sentences.en: and then finds refuge in Russia.
sentences.zh: 然后跑到俄罗斯寻求避难。
弗拉基米尔·普京的俄罗斯。

sentences.en: What fascinated me about this debate was how quickly people came to their conclusions.
sentences.zh: 这场辩论令我着迷的是，人们得出结论的速度竟是如此之快。

sentences.en: How certain they were that they were right.
sentences.zh: 他们对自己的正确性是多么笃定。

sentences.en: Today we explore what happens when two core moral values are pitted against each other.
sentences.zh: 今天我们将探讨当两个核心道德价值观针锋相对时会发生什么。

sentences.en: Darwin Rocher grew up in Detroit, Michigan in the 1970s and 80s.
sentences.zh: 达尔文·罗彻于20世纪70和80年代在密歇根州底特律长大。
他的父亲是一名机械装配工。

sentences.en: He dismantled, repaired, and reassembled huge pieces of machinery in a steel factory.
sentences.zh: 他在一家钢铁厂里拆卸、修理和重新组装巨大的机械设备。

sentences.en: Darwin's mom stayed at home to raise him and his sister.
sentences.zh: 达尔文的母亲则全职在家抚养他和他的姐姐。

sentences.en: She'd help them with their homework, give them life advice.
sentences.zh: 她会帮他们辅导功课，给他们生活上的建议。

sentences.en: She'd also whip up big family dinners every Sunday evening.
sentences.zh: 她还会在每周日晚上精心准备丰盛的家庭晚餐。

sentences.en: I can't recall any, like, really adverse childhood experiences that I went through
sentences.zh: 我记不起有什么真正逆境般的童年经历，

sentences.en: as a kid and as well as a young adult and a teenager.
sentences.zh: 无论是作为孩子、年轻人还是青少年时期。

sentences.en: So I had a pretty good lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 所以我有着相当不错的生活方式。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed being a kid.
sentences.zh: 我真的很享受当孩子的时光。

sentences.en: Darwin's parents were loving, kind, church-going folks.
sentences.zh: 达尔文的父母都是慈祥、善良、笃信宗教的人。

sentences.en: They tried to impress the right values on young Darwin.
sentences.zh: 他们试图将正确的价值观铭刻在小达尔文的心中。

sentences.en: Doing the right thing for the right reasons.
sentences.zh: 出于正确的理由做正确的事。

sentences.en: Being a person of honesty and integrity.
And doing it right the first time in everything that you do.
sentences.zh: 而且无论做什么，从一开始就要做对。

sentences.en: When Darwin was around 12 years old, he violated his parents' moral code.
sentences.zh: 当达尔文大约12岁时，他触犯了父母的道德准则。

sentences.en: One day, he snuck into a neighbor's yard and picked some of her flowers.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他溜进邻居的院子摘了一些花。

sentences.en: As he was walking home with his freshly assembled bouquet,
sentences.zh: 当他手里拿着刚拼凑好的花束走在回家路上时，

sentences.en: the neighbor called his mom and told her what he'd done.
sentences.zh: 邻居打电话给他母亲，告发了他的所作所为。

sentences.en: My mom really got after me about doing that.
sentences.zh: 我妈因为这事狠狠地训斥了我一顿。

sentences.en: And she was telling me how important it is to respect other people's property.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我尊重别人的财产是多么重要。

sentences.en: So the punishment or, I guess, the reward would be that I had to do yard service for her
sentences.zh: 所以我的惩罚——或者说变相的奖励——就是我必须在剩下的夏天里

sentences.en: I had to cut her grass and everything like that.
Darwin said this lesson taught him what kind of person he wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 达尔文说，这个教训让他明白了自己想成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: At home, he became the model's son.
sentences.zh: 在家里，他成了模范儿子。

sentences.en: At school, he got good grades.
But when he was 16, he received a different kind of lesson.
sentences.zh: 但当他16岁时，他上了另一种课。

sentences.en: A lesson that taught him what kind of person he didn't want to be.
sentences.zh: 一个让他明白自己不想成为什么样的人的教训。

sentences.en: He was driving to pick up his sister from school.
sentences.zh: 他正开车去接妹妹放学。

sentences.en: Two friends were in the car with him.
sentences.zh: 车里还有他的两个朋友。

sentences.en: All of the boys were black.
Suddenly, in his rearview mirror, Darwin saw the flashing lights of a police car.
sentences.zh: 突然，达尔文在后视镜里看到了一辆警车闪烁的警灯。

sentences.en: And so I didn't think anything of it because I've never had any negative encounters with law enforcement at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时没多想，因为我以前从来没有和执法人员有过任何负面接触。

sentences.en: There were four officers in the squad car.

sentences.zh: 其中一人向达尔文走来。

sentences.en: So the officer approached the driver's side door and he asked me for my driver's license.
sentences.zh: 警官走到驾驶室门旁，向我要驾照。

sentences.en: Darwin knew his license was in the car, probably in the side pocket of the door.
sentences.zh: 达尔文知道驾照在车里，大概在车门侧边的兜里。

sentences.en: Something told him not to reach for it.
sentences.zh: 但某种直觉告诉他不要去拿。

sentences.en: So I said, my driver's license is here, but I just don't know where it's located.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，我的驾照在车里，但我就是不知道具体在哪个位置。

sentences.en: And so at that point, he ordered all three of us out the car.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他命令我们三个人全部下车。

sentences.en: And then he told us to put our hands on the trunk of the car, of my car,
sentences.zh: 然后他叫我们把手按在车尾箱上，也就是我的车上，

sentences.en: while they searched the interior of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 同时他们开始搜查车内。

sentences.en: And then the officer walked back to me and said,
sentences.zh: 接着这位警官走回我身边说：

sentences.en: hey, I found your driver's license.
And he held it in his left hand and he showed it to me.
sentences.zh: 他用左手拿着驾照向我展示。

sentences.en: And I smiled because I was happy because I didn't know where it was at.
sentences.zh: 我笑了，因为我很高兴，之前我都不知道它放在哪。

sentences.en: And then he slapped me in the face very hard and told me to wipe that smile off my face.
sentences.zh: 紧接着他狠狠地扇了我一记耳光，并叫我把脸上的笑容收起来。

sentences.en: He took his hand and did like a clamp around my throat, squeezing my Adam's apple.
sentences.zh: 他用手像个夹子一样卡住我的喉咙，死死掐住我的喉结。

sentences.en: At one point, Darwin looked at the other three officers.
sentences.zh: 有一刻，达尔文看向另外三名警官。

sentences.en: And the other officers kind of, they were black males and they kind of just kind of shrugged away.
sentences.zh: 而另外几名警官——他们也是黑人男性——只是有点耸了耸肩避开目光。

sentences.en: And I was kind of looking at them like, you know, are you going to allow this to happen?
sentences.zh: 我当时看着他们，心里想：你们知道吗，你们打算就这么任由事情发生吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to allow someone to assault me?
sentences.zh: 你们打算任由别人殴打我吗？

sentences.en: And I'm 16 years old and I haven't done anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 当时我才16岁，而且我什么都没做错。

sentences.en: And so at that point, they kind of just kind of went along to get along and didn't do anything to intervene.
sentences.zh: 所以在那种情况下，他们只是随波逐流，没有采取任何干预措施。

sentences.en: And then the encounter lasted for about five minutes.
sentences.zh: 整个冲突过程持续了大约五分钟。

sentences.en: But that five minutes, I thought that they were actually going to kill me because he told me when he choked me,
sentences.zh: 但在那五分钟里，我以为他们真的会杀了我要，因为他在掐我的时候跟我说：

sentences.en: the only reason I won't kill you out here is because it's daylight.
sentences.zh: 我今天不在外面杀了你的唯一原因，就是现在是大白天。

sentences.en: After the incident, Darwin thought about what had happened.
sentences.zh: 事件发生后，达尔文一直在回想这件事。

sentences.en: He thought about the officer who had choked him.
sentences.zh: 他想到了那个掐他的警官。

sentences.en: But he also thought about the other three officers who had watched and done nothing.
sentences.zh: 但他也想到了其他三个在一旁观看却什么都没做的警官。

sentences.en: Why did they hesitate to speak up?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么犹豫着不敢开口？

sentences.en: Did they not want to break ranks with their fellow officer?
sentences.zh: 是不想破坏与同僚之间的官场默契吗？

sentences.en: I was hoping and thinking maybe one of those officers would have the courage to, you know, stand forth and say,
sentences.zh: 我当时希望并且觉得，也许其中某一个警官会有勇气站出来说：

sentences.en: okay, this officer's out here assaulting, you know, teenagers in broad daylight for no crime whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 好了，这家伙可是在光天化日之下，在对方根本没犯任何罪的情况下殴打青少年。

sentences.en: The encounter left Darwin with a concussion.
sentences.zh: 这次冲突给达尔文留下了脑震荡。

sentences.en: But the injustice of what had happened stayed with him long after the physical pain had eased.
sentences.zh: 但事件所带来的不公感，在身体的痛苦消退很久之后依然萦绕在他心头。

sentences.en: He sometimes asked himself what he would have done if he had been one of the three officers who had witnessed the assault.
sentences.zh: 他有时会问自己，如果当时自己是目睹这场殴打的那三名警察之一，他会怎么做。

sentences.en: If a situation arose where he had to choose between loyalty and honesty, would he hesitate to speak up?
sentences.zh: 如果出现必须在忠诚和诚实之间做出选择的情况，他会犹豫着不敢发声吗？

sentences.en: He was soon to find out the answer.
After a stint in the Air Force, Darwin eventually became a police officer in Detroit himself.
sentences.zh: 在空军服役一段时间后，达尔文最终自己也成了底特律的一名警察。

sentences.en: He rose in the ranks and gained the respect of his fellow officers.
sentences.zh: 他不断晋升，赢得了同僚们的尊重。

sentences.en: Soon, work and life began to blur together.
sentences.zh: 很快，工作与生活开始模糊不清。

sentences.en: Darwin felt especially close to one of his scout partners.
sentences.zh: 达尔文觉得他和其中一位巡逻搭档格外亲密。

sentences.en: They'd go out and patrol together almost every day.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎每天都一起出警巡逻。

sentences.en: And he really taught me how to be a street officer.
sentences.zh: 他真的教会了我如何成为一名街头警察。

sentences.en: He taught me how to detect crime, drug, narcotics, trafficking, those sort of things.
sentences.zh: 他教我如何侦查犯罪、毒品、麻醉品走私以及诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: He was a street cop, and he was very good at his craft.
sentences.zh: 他是个地道的街头警察，而且业务能力非常强。

sentences.en: On weekends, they'd watch sports together.
sentences.zh: 周末时，他们会一起看体育比赛。

sentences.en: They celebrated milestones with their families.
sentences.zh: 他们和各自的家人一起庆祝人生的重要时刻。

sentences.en: He was just a good guy.
When he would come home to my house, I had a young child at that time.
sentences.zh: 当他来我家时，我当时还有一个年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: He would kind of, you know, ask me about the kid and ask me, did I need anything?
sentences.zh: 他会主动问起孩子的情况，问我需不需要什么帮助，

sentences.en: Because, you know, I was a newer officer.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时是个新警员嘛。

sentences.en: And he just kind of took on a big brother role for me in certain aspects.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，他扮演了类似于兄长的角色。

sentences.en: Darwin had another scout partner he was close to.
sentences.zh: 达尔文还有另一个关系密切的巡逻搭档。

sentences.en: For reasons that will become clear later in the story, we are not naming Darwin's fellow cops.
sentences.zh: 出于故事后面会明了的原因，我们隐去了达尔文这些同行警察的名字。

sentences.en: Darwin felt he had a real bond with his second partner.
sentences.zh: 达尔文觉得他和第二位搭档有着真正的羁绊。

sentences.en: He was more quiet, soft-spoken, a good partner.
sentences.zh: 他比较安静、温和，是个好搭档。

sentences.en: When we worked together, we would go and investigate things on a deep level
sentences.zh: 当我们一起工作时，我们会深入调查各种事情，

sentences.en: because we were anxious to get out there on the streets,
sentences.zh: 因为我们渴望到街上去，

sentences.en: and we wanted just to patrol and have fun.
There was a third colleague Darwin respected enormously.
sentences.zh: 还有第三位同事是达尔文极其尊敬的。

sentences.en: When they worked together, Darwin always felt he came away
sentences.zh: 每当他们一起工作时，达尔文总觉得自已能够收获

sentences.en: with a better understanding of what it meant to be a Detroit police officer.
sentences.zh: 对底特律警察职责更深刻的理解。

sentences.en: Me being a new officer, they kind of tell you, write a lot of tickets,
sentences.zh: 作为一个新警察，他们通常会告诉你：多开罚单，

sentences.en: get a lot of citations, get some stats.
And he kind of explained to me that these tickets that you write these people
sentences.zh: 而他向我解释说，你给这些人开的这些罚单

sentences.en: have a monetary impact, adverse impact on them.
sentences.zh: 会对他们造成金钱上的冲击和负面影响。

sentences.en: He said, you know it's okay to give out a warning.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，有时候给个警告也是可以的。

sentences.en: You know, at certain times, so it was those intangibles that you didn't learn
sentences.zh: 你知道，在某些时候，正是那些你在警校里学不到的、

sentences.en: in the academy on how to be a patrol officer for the city of Detroit.
sentences.zh: 关于如何当好底特律市巡警的无形经验。

sentences.en: The brotherhood he formed with these officers gave Darwin a sense of security.
sentences.zh: 他与这些警察建立的兄弟情谊给了达尔文一种安全感。

sentences.en: The cops knew each other's families.
sentences.zh: 警察们都认识彼此的家属。

sentences.en: When they were out on dangerous calls, Darwin felt like he could trust these men
sentences.zh: 当他们出勤执行危险任务时，达尔文觉得自己可以信任这些人

sentences.en: to watch his back to keep him safe.
sentences.zh: 让他们在背后支持自己，确保自己安全。

sentences.en: And of course, he knew he would do the same for them.
sentences.zh: 当然，他也知道自己会为他们做出同样的事情。

sentences.en: One night in 1998, the four men got together for a beer at a dive bar on the east side of Detroit.
sentences.zh: 1998年的一天晚上，这四个人在底特律东区的一家小酒吧里聚在一起喝啤酒。

sentences.en: We had drinks, we talked about sports, we talked about police work, we talked about women,
sentences.zh: 我们喝着酒，谈论着体育，谈论着警务工作，谈论着女性

sentences.en: and things that people do at their age group.
sentences.zh: 以及他们这个年龄段的人会做的事情。

sentences.en: And then the conversation went in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 接着，谈话转向了一个新的方向。

sentences.en: One of his scout partners asked Darwin a question.
sentences.zh: 他的一个巡逻搭档问了达尔文一个问题。

sentences.en: Do you want to make some money?
And I said, well, of course.
I mean, what do you want to do?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你想做什么？

sentences.en: And he said, well, I got an idea.
The officer told Darwin about a bookie who had just been released from prison
sentences.zh: 这名警官告诉达尔文，有一个刚从监狱释放的地下庄家

sentences.en: for tax evasion and illegal gambling.
sentences.zh: 他因逃税和非法赌博而入狱。

sentences.en: The bookie had stashed a million dollars in a safe at his house.
sentences.zh: 这个庄家在他家里的保险箱里藏了一百万美元。

sentences.en: And we're going to go in there and we're going to get it.
sentences.zh: 我们要进去把它拿出来。

sentences.en: And I know that you're a young officer and they don't pay well.
sentences.zh: 我知道你是个年轻警官，薪水不高。
你还有一个年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: And you can put some, you know, some coins in your pocket.
sentences.zh: 你可以往口袋里塞点，你知道的，塞点零花钱。

sentences.en: And it's just a one-time shot.
We go in, we go out.
And then we can be set for a very long time to come.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在很长的一段时间里都能衣食无忧了。

sentences.en: It was like the plot of a movie.
sentences.zh: 这就像电影里的情节一样。
达尔文坐在那里，惊呆了。

sentences.en: At first I thought it was a joke.
I thought it was, aha, very, very funny.
sentences.zh: 我以为是，哈哈，非常非常搞笑。

sentences.en: But as the conversation continued, he started to draw a diagram of the target house
sentences.zh: 但随着谈话的继续，他开始画出目标房屋的草图

sentences.en: and how we would approach this house.
